name: Amritsar: The Golden Temple

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the third Decade (4 rounds each)

categories.label: Prestige Points (PP) earned during game
categories.hint: PP marked on the track after the third Decade scoring (including majorities).

categories.label: Knowledge Tracks
categories.hint: PP printed on the last space reached on each Knowledge Track.

categories.label: Played Objectives
categories.hint: Reveal the Objectives placed on your board and score each one if fulfilled.

categories.label: District Tile end-game effects
categories.labelVi: Hiệu ứng cuối game của Tile
categories.hint: Only if you have such tile effects: 1 PP per leftover Donation Counter on Elephant, per Resource, or per Coin.

categories.label: Donations to the Golden Temple (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Quyên góp cho Đền Vàng (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Number of donations to the Golden Temple.

tiebreakers.description: Most donations made to the Golden Temple
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Only a third-party rulebook transcription (RulesPal) could be reached; official PDF/BGG pages were not accessible, so values are not verified against the printed rulebook. Objective values vary per card (majority 5/2 PP, knowledge 5-6 PP, donation spread tables); enter the total. Decade scoring (district majorities, taxes, income) is in-game and tracked on PP. Solo Maharajah mode not modelled.
